title: Stability AI Completes $76 Million Series B: EA and Three Major Record Labels Invest Together

content_html:
Stability AI announced on the 25th in California time that it has completed a $76 million Series B funding round. The funds will be used to drive the development of creative production products, deepen applied research, and expand professional service businesses.

The list of investors in this round is unique: game giant EA, three global music entertainment companies (Sony Music, Universal Music, Warner Music), and AMD's venture capital department have all participated in the investment.

CEO Prem Akkaraju said that this investor group confirms the vision of "empowering every producer, musician, and storyteller with generative AI." He emphasized that what makes Stability different is that it is "a creator building tools for creators." Investors not only provide money but also bring expertise, credibility, and direct access to artists — this layer of industrial capital binding also reflects that AI companies and content rights holders are moving from confrontation to coexistence.
